invariants.rule: A confirmed centre uses at least three consecutive completed components.
After confirmation, ZD_ticks and ZG_ticks are immutable for that centre_id.
Components from different analysis_level or component_kind values cannot form one centre.
Nine or more extension components trigger centre promotion recognition.
B3 requires a completed departure and the first completed retest.
B3 requires retest_low_ticks > ZG_ticks; equality means extension.
S3 requires retest_high_ticks < ZD_ticks; equality means extension.
Standard trend divergence requires at least two same-level non-overlapping centres.
Standard trend divergence requires a new directional extreme in the final leg.
Indicators cannot create a structural signal without structural prerequisites.
A B2 below B1 is weak and requires consolidation divergence plus lower-level completion.
confirmed_at is not earlier than endpoint_time.
Backtest execution is not earlier than confirmed_at.
An unfinished final leg can emit only a candidate signal.
Boundary comparisons use integer minimum-tick units, not floating epsilon.
Stroke-centre experimental signals are never mixed with standard segment-centre signals.
Invalidated candidates remain auditable and are not silently deleted.
